description: The tibia is the weight-bearing shin bone whose sharp crest and broad planes give the lower leg its structural clarity.

landmarks.name: Medial condyle
landmarks.desc: Medial plateau of the proximal tibia that receives the femoral condyle and supports the knee's inner mass.

landmarks.name: Lateral condyle
landmarks.desc: Lateral tibial plateau that meets the femoral condyle and blends into the fibular head.

landmarks.name: Tibial tuberosity
landmarks.desc: Anterior bump below the knee where the patellar ligament anchors.

landmarks.name: Anterior crest
landmarks.desc: Sharp ridge running down the shin that catches light and guides the leg's contour.

landmarks.name: Medial surface
landmarks.desc: Flat medial plane lying close to the skin, often visible in lean figures.

landmarks.name: Soleal line
landmarks.desc: Oblique ridge on the posterior surface marking the attachment of the soleus.

landmarks.name: Pes anserinus area
landmarks.desc: Medial proximal flare where the sartorius, gracilis, and semitendinosus converge.

landmarks.name: Posterior medial condyle
landmarks.desc: Posterior groove on the medial condyle where the semimembranosus tendon fans out.

landmarks.name: Medial malleolus
landmarks.desc: Distal medial projection forming the inner ankle.

landmarks.name: Inferior articular surface
landmarks.desc: Distal tibial plafond that meets the talus to close the ankle mortise.
